usedFor: Every booked 42min meeting starts as a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in 42min, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A booking can be limited to one event type, so only sales calls become deals.

watchOut: Use “Updated Booking Time” with an existing deal, not “Create Deal”, or a reschedule adds a second deal.
